verdict.rationale: The pack never documents user-facing custom field creation or filtered, sorted, or shared views. Kanban views (freshsales-docs-17), the Custom Modules API (freshsales-docs-16) and the Lists API (freshsales-docs-14) are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the story's capability. Since a CRM could plausibly offer this, the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project
